title: プロジェクトデザインⅢ(池永訓昭研究室)
subtitle: Design Project III(Ikenaga Noriaki)
keywords: Plasma generation / measurement 2.Ion / radical species 3.Functional thin film / regional collaboration 4.Physical sensor
educationalGoal: Utilize knowledge and skills acquired so far to acquire vacuum technology and thin film fabrication technology. Find new themes such as new functional thin film materials with a view to application from close relations with industry, and focus on developing the ability to plan and execute research to achieve the objectives. In particular, it deals with themes that make full use of plasma. The goal is to acquire comprehensive skills as an engineer.
advice: Students will persevere under the advice of their supervisors about the research themes they are working on, and obtain new knowledge while solving problems. Through research activities (project activities), acquire problem-finding / solving ability, self-development / self-management ability, communication ability, literature research ability, importance of safety inspection, and ethical judgment ability as an engineer. Aiming to actively present research results at academic societies, etc., so that questions and answers can be made accurately among experts. Specific lessons are as follows: 1.Project activities: Divide into 1 or 2 people for each research theme. In the previous semester, we will mainly study basic knowledge and literature on plasma and functional thin films. In the second semester, students will learn basic research skills and communication skills by working on each research theme and at the same time summarizing the research results and reporting on the progress of each research theme. 2.Presentation of research results: In the second semester, oral presentations will be made at various academic societies for each research theme. In addition, regarding themes related to joint research with companies, other universities, and public institutions, we participate in regular meetings and actively participate in discussions to conduct specialized Q & A training. . Eventually, a project design III report will be created and presented at a public presentation.
requiredKnowledge: In order to handle plasma, basic knowledge about the behavior of charged particles ("electromagnetism") must be understood. In addition, since improvements and repairs of the equipment are also required, prior knowledge of “electrical circuits”, “transient phenomena”, and “electrical materials” is also necessary, so it is important to review and deepen your understanding.

activityGoals.body: To be able to acquire basic vacuum technology and design more advanced vacuum equipment
To be able to explain scientific definition of plasma and basic calculations on behavior of charged particles
To be able to understand and apply various technologies using ions and plasma
To be able to acquire thin film fabrication technology using plasma and apply it to various fields
To be able to appropriately communicate your thoughts to third parties through discussions and presentations

achievementLevels.ideal: *Understand the purpose of the research theme and develop and execute research plans to achieve the goal. *Appropriate evaluation and analysis of various functional thin films. *Can propose themes of different fields (regional collaboration, etc.) utilizing research results. *Summarize research results and present them at specialized academic societies and gain high acclaim from outside.
achievementLevels.standard: *Understand the purpose of the research theme and explain problems . *Perform experiments necessary to achieve the objectives of the research theme and summarize the results obtained. *Further problems can be found from the obtained results. *Present research results at academic societies and progress reports.

lessons.content: *Acquisition of basic knowledge on plasma and functional thin films. *Acquisition of handling of various devices. *Drafting a research plan.
lessons.operation: Lectures and practical training at seminars. Meeting the research plan for each team.
lessons.assignments: Understand the contents of the lecture more deeply through literature surveys. Review the handling of various experimental devices and be able to handle them safely and accurately.

lessons.operation: Lectures at seminars and progress reports for each team.
lessons.assignments: Understand the points that can not be understood in the research content more deeply through literature surveys. Summarize experimental results as graphs or tables so that you can report them to third parties.

lessons.assignments: While logically summarizing the research that has been conducted so far, create presentation materials and explain them to third parties in an easy-to-understand manner.
